edge_sign_policy: Rank signs by initial plus terminal occurrence count in strict numeric-clean lipi rows. For each removal policy, remove those signs from every sequence, drop empty rows, optionally collapse exact duplicate resulting sequences, then rerun order, masked-sign, and leakage-controlled held-out checks.
interpretation_boundary: High-frequency-edge-removal T3 structural scout only; stored-order and masked-sign results are not sign values, semantics, phonetics, or translations.
